Author: Nyaughty
Name: Onion
Punchline: Mods are like onions, they have layers!
Description: Install skin mods as layers and not as skin replacements. Designed to work across female bodies, works with OMP files and Proteus mods.
Changelog:
- Onion mods now show their layer number (priority) next to them.
- You can easily re-order them with the arrow keys - picking the next available slot to avoid conflicts

Author: Nyaughty
Name: ReAnimate
Punchline: Poses are like onions--- err wrong notebook
Description: Turn your current pose into an idle pose with a single click in no time.
Changelog:
- New icon
- The swap tab tells you where swaps land and how to undo one
- A swap now says which mod it went into
- Fixed: swapping into a mod with no option groups made a separate mod instead of going inside it
